Hi Tymoteusz,

Thanks for catching this so quickly, and good timing: nothing on order Shop···· has been packed or labelled yet.

Szymon Z.

I would rather tell you that now than say it is finished before it really is.

You will have confirmation from us as soon as the warehouse side is set, and the tracking will follow when the Wingbits WB200 ships.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
